respins.how_it_works:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus maintains the mechanics of the SPIN-DEPENDENCE DAY bonus. In addition, at least 5 Liberty Gems will land on each spin, not including the Freedom Respins!

wilds.name: LIBERTY GEMS
wilds.behavior:
The Liberty Gem symbol acts as a Wild multiplier that substitutes for the other paying symbols in the paytable. Landing Liberty Gems triggers a Freedom Respin, with all Liberty Gems staying on the grid during that spin. If more Liberty Gems land, another Freedom Respin is awarded. This continues until no new Liberty Gems land or there are no more available positions. Wins are awarded during each Respin.

 When a Liberty Gem symbol participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the Gem’s multiplier value. If more than one Liberty Gem symbol is part of the same winning combination, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Liberty Gem symbols will display one of the following multiplier values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x and 10x.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - PURSUIT OF RICHES
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus maintains the mechanics of the SPIN-DEPENDENCE DAY bonus. In addition, at least 5 Liberty Gems will land on each spin, not including the Freedom Respins!

multipliers.name: GEM CLUSTERS
multipliers.behavior:
Landing 4 or more Liberty Gems in a square formation of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 will form a Gem Cluster. A Gem Cluster can grow if additional Liberty Gems land around the existing Cluster in such a way that they collectively form a larger square formation, for example, growing from 2x2 to 3x3. A Gem Cluster can only be formed in these exact square formats. When a Gem Cluster forms it can appear in two different ways. In a Classic Cluster, the multiplier values of each Gem are added together to create one final multiplier.

 In an Epic Cluster, all multiplier values are first added together, and the total is then multiplied by a value between x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10 and x20 to determine the final multiplier.

 The final multipliers will be applied to each winning payline the Cluster is part of.
